result_text:
I changed `exportZips()` in `reports/.../dataexporters/DataExporter.java` so `all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured scope aspect names. It looks them up with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName`, the same helper the loose `aspect_<name>.txt` files are written with. I also added the `NamedSourceCodeAspect` import.

- **Default config:** the entries should be unchanged and in the same order: `aspect_main.txt`, `aspect_test.txt`, `aspect_generated.txt`, `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`, `aspect_other.txt`.
- **Renamed aspect:** with the name `buildAndDeployment`, the fourth entry should become `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. The zip no longer fails on a missing file, so `git-history.zip` gets written too when `git-history.txt` exists.
- **Verification:** the module compiles. I didn't run any tests and didn't try a renamed aspect, so none of the above has been checked at runtime.

I haven't committed anything.
